what: The numbers of the tour's last step (Where the map said safe): the streets outside every official flood zone. Edit them here, no code: the page reads this file as it is. The older options (the three rains) are kept for the record and no longer shown.

options.label: Real rain
options.line: Run with the rain that fell on 29 Oct 2024.

options.label: The same morning
options.found_text: with the forecast of that morning
options.line: Simulated, driven by the ECMWF forecast of 29 Oct 2024, 06 UTC, which reached forecasters between 12:45 and 13:12 local, about 5 hours before Chiva's streets flooded.
options.source: data/streets/results.json streets_more_runs.main.methods.simulated_ifs_20241029T06_depth_above_0p3m.A.total (hit_rate_pct 21.0, precision_pct 70.1, flagged_km 154.14), street-sim run A3 (PR #54); the times in its line: docs/STREETS.md, run A3, Why (ECMWF dissemination schedule as read on 15 Nov 2026)

options.label: The night before
options.found_text: with the forecast of the night before
options.line: Simulated, driven by the ECMWF forecast of 29 Oct 2024, 00 UTC, run the night before the flood.
options.source: data/streets/results.json streets_more_runs.main.methods.simulated_ifs_20241029T00_depth_above_0p3m.A.total (hit_rate_pct 26.1, precision_pct 70.9, flagged_km 188.92), street-sim run A1 (PR #50)

ceiling.text: Even two official records of this flood only match each other at about 80%.
ceiling.source: data/streets/results.json streets_more_runs.main.ceiling.key_b_against_key_a.total: the UPV depth map against key A (Copernicus EMS map and water marks), 84.2% found and 78.9% really flooded, inside the UPV outlines (PR #50)

closing: Open code, every test written down before the answer was seen.

safe.line: of flooded streets outside every official zone that our model found, two thirds of all the streets the map left out.
safe.small: It needs only rain and terrain, and runs a 25-hour storm in about half an hour.
safe.source: data/streets/results.json streets.main.descriptive: simulated_outside_zones.A.total (flagged_and_flooded_km 205.41, precision_pct 70.6), key_a_flooded_km_outside_every_zone 303.07 (205.41 of 303.07 is 67.8%, two thirds), outside_zones_chance_precision.A 23.1; half an hour: streets_more_runs simulation_runs, 25-hour runs of 1,818 s and 1,925 s (ifs_20241029T00, ifs_20241029T06)
